comment: Sample of S:/Repos/trick-or-treat/art/asset_catalog.json (2026-10-25, 11 of 184 entries chosen to show every field). See docs/catalog-schema.md.

assets.brief: Plump squat pumpkin 0.6 m wide, 0.45 m tall, 8 soft lobes, curly stem. Readable ridges.
Round leafy shrub about 1.1 m wide, 0.85 m tall: dark core lumps covered by ~380 small pointed leaf cards (14 cm) in hedge_dark / hedge / vine with moss tips on top, a sprinkle of tiny cream flowers.
Terracotta pot 0.5 m with orange mums (maple_orange / golden_leaf blobs).

1.1 m child in a plush teal dragon onesie: hood with two tiny cream horns, round face showing (skin, big ink eyes with white highlights, pink cheeks), cream belly, stubby felt wings on the back, a fat bouncy tail, mitten hands, round boots. Holds an orange jack-o'-lantern bucket (glowing face cut, rope handle) in the right hand. Every part is its own object parented to an empty root 'dragon_kid' at the feet; each part's origin sits at its joint (hips for legs, shoulders for arms, neck for head, wing roots, tail base) so the game can animate it procedurally. bucket is a child of arm_r; bucket_candy is a child of bucket (a heap of candy inside it that the game scales from 0 to 1 as it fills).
Cute round bat 0.5 m wingspan, charcoal, with wing_l / wing_r child objects (origin at the shoulder) so the game can flap them.
Taller pumpkin 0.5 m wide, 0.6 m tall, pumpkin_light tone with pumpkin_dark grooves.

Round backyard trampoline ~3.75 m across (pad outer radius 1.87 m), origin at ground centre. Dark plum woven mat, top exactly 0.85 m, printed with a big jack-o'-lantern inside an orange target ring and faint bats; bone-stitched purple border; ring of 40 steel springs; puffy orange safety pad (alternating pumpkin panels, purple skirt) rising ~6 cm above the mat; 6 curved steel W-legs; small purple-step ladder on the front-right (-62 deg, reaches r 2.2 m). No enclosure net. bounce = launch speed for gameplay.
Oversized sunflower 2.4 m tall, head 0.9 m across facing -Y and tilted slightly down, big leaves on the stalk.
Round twist-wrapped sweet in raspberry with white polka dots and pale pink fans. About 0.32 m across; origin at its centre (it floats and spins).

Raised brick planter 2.0 x 0.9 x 0.55 m (X long): brick walls, stone cap course, soil, planted with mums and two small pumpkins. Cap/soil top is flat at 0.55 m; plants rise above it (collision_top caps the box collision at the cap).

Tiny glowing jack-o'-lantern bulb 0.14 m for porch string lights: ribbed glow_jack_shell globe with a glow_jack_hot carved face toward -Y, green stem and black lamp socket. Origin at the top of the socket (the wire hang point); socket_light at the globe centre. Instanced along sagging wires.
